name: War-Awoken Phantom Assault (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Dark/NE piercing summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Dark Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has at least 0/40% Dark Damage
WS Blue: Dark Damage +30% to all allies
WS Gold: Sorcery Damage +20% to all allies
